Lemma
[$\mu $ under Cheeger--Gromov convergence] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0402 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants 1. appD:D.39\group Perelman Invariants

If $(\mathcal N_k,g_k,x_k)$ converges smoothly in the pointed Cheeger--Gromov sense to $(\mathcal N_\infty ,g_\infty ,x_\infty )$, then for every $\tau >0$, \[ \mu (g_\infty ,\tau )\geq \limsup _{k\to \infty }\mu (g_k,\tau ). \]
